name: Vine Center
summary: Vine Center is a neighborhood shopping center in Livermore anchored by Vine Cinema, providing convenient retail and entertainment options for the local community. Located on First Street, the center serves the growing Tri-Valley area with a mix of tenants focused on everyday needs and leisure activities.
demographics: Vine Center attracts a diverse mix of Livermore residents and visitors, primarily families and young professionals aged 25-55 with middle to upper-middle income levels. The trade area serves the growing Tri-Valley region, drawing from households with median incomes above the California average who value entertainment and dining experiences. Typical visitors include movie-goers seeking a local cinema experience, often combining their visit with dining at nearby restaurants, reflecting the area's preference for convenient, neighborhood-oriented entertainment venues.
description: Vine Center is a neighborhood shopping destination located in the heart of Livermore, California, at 1722 First Street. The center is anchored by the popular Vine Cinema, a beloved local movie theater that has served the Tri-Valley community for years, offering residents a convenient entertainment option close to home. The property features a mix of retail and service tenants that cater to the daily needs of Livermore's growing population. With its prime First Street location, Vine Center benefits from strong visibility and accessibility in one of the East Bay's most dynamic communities. The center maintains a welcoming, community-focused atmosphere that reflects Livermore's small-town charm while serving the needs of modern shoppers and entertainment seekers.
